decisions.reason: The UV spot varnishing system was launched with a public German premiere and is presented as a flagship of the firm's move into embellishment, so the firm will keep backing it despite its distance from the core and the lack of reported results.
The sheet preparation module complements the firm's modular systems at little cost, and no negative signal justifies weakening the integrated offer.
The B2 multifinisher sits on the home page as a flagship of the announced automation direction and is tied to the core Duplo partnership, so commitment strongly favors persistence.
The hybrid saddle stitcher lies in the firm's booklet-making core and has its own product page, making it a natural, low-risk part of the portfolio.
The folding add-on has a documented customer installation combined with the core creasing system, so its positive evidence supports keeping it.
